subject: KeyPose status: bottle/cup reproduced, heart category is the outlier
body:
Hi both,

Status ahead of the mid-window check-in. Reproduction milestone is done: on the released bottle and cup models we match published keypoint accuracy — mean 3D keypoint error within 0.4mm of the reference numbers, using the standard texture_5 evaluation splits.

Two findings worth flagging:
1) The heart category is a consistent outlier — its symmetric shape makes keypoint identity ambiguous, and errors are ~3x the other categories. Our pilot objects (two tumblers, one jar) are more bottle-like, so this shouldn't block the demo, but it bounds which SKUs we can promise.
2) Leilani finished the rig calibration pass; RGB/depth pixel registration now matches the public dataset's setup, so fine-tuning uses the same input contract as the release.

Risk: pilot capture is running about 4 days behind because the lab cell was double-parked with another team's arm through last week. Still compatible with Jun 26 if capture starts Monday.

Yara
